items.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
items.summary: A practical guide covering how startups can select GPT-6 models, adjust reasoning effort, refine prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production use.
items.why: Helps freelancers and small teams pick the right GPT-6 model and set up production workflows.

items.title: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
items.summary: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign capital markets workflows, reducing trade validation time from 30 minutes to under 4 minutes.
items.why: Shows how AI can compress repetitive financial workflows for small firms.

items.title: The eternal complement
items.summary: An essay arguing that advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas, and that execution could shape the next economy and pace of progress.
items.why: Frames AI as a force multiplier for the execution work freelancers do daily.

items.title: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
items.summary: Albertsons Companies uses ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help internal teams work faster and improve the grocery shopping experience for millions of customers.
items.why: Demonstrates how enterprise AI tools can streamline operations in large organizations.

items.title: The Den frees up 10-15 hours a week to grow with ChatGPT Work
items.summary: The Den, a family social club, uses ChatGPT Work to free up 10-15 hours weekly. Grant applications now take 2 hours instead of 3 days; liquor-license materials take 3 hours instead of 4 days.
items.why: A concrete example of how a small business cuts admin time with AI.

items.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it disrupted a coordinated campaign aimed at extracting protected model reasoning and outlines steps to strengthen defenses against adversarial distillation attacks.
items.why: Signals that model IP protection is becoming a real operational concern.

items.title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
items.summary: OpenAI is partnering with America's SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.
items.why: Free local training and a report on small-team AI use are directly useful.

items.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
items.summary: A recap of more than 20 announcements from OpenAI DevDay 2026, covering GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security updates, and new tools for builders.
items.why: A single source for the latest developer-facing tools and API changes.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: GPT-6.1 Sol offers near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra's standard API input and output token prices.
items.why: A cheaper model with strong capability is a cost win for API-dependent projects.

items.title: Introducing dots
items.summary: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks, designed to help users stay in control while work moves forward.
items.why: Autonomous task handling could reduce the need to babysit AI workflows.
